tout_compris.title: VISA, TRANSFERS, ACCOMMODATION, 2 MEALS/DAY, COACHING
tout_compris.body: The price covers the Russian visa (fees and file), airport-camp transfers, accommodation, 2 meals per day, the 2 daily training sessions and local coaching. Your flights to Makhachkala (Wrestling) or Grozny (MMA) via Istanbul stay on your side, but you do not choose them alone: MKR helps you find the right route and timings that match the airport pickup. The full details are on the Camp page.
